searchTerms.title: Keywords
searchTerms.description: Job titles or keywords, e.g. data engineer, nurse, electrician. Each is its own search. Empty searches all jobs matching the filters.

location.title: Location
location.description: As written on the site, e.g. Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Metro Manila, Jakarta, Bangkok, Central Region (Singapore), Kwun Tong District (Hong Kong). Empty for the whole country.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Seek categories, e.g. Accounting, Administration & Office Support, Advertising, Arts & Media, Banking & Financial Services, Call Centre & Customer Service, CEO & General Management… (all 30 are accepted, or Seek's numeric ids). Empty for all.

workTypes.title: Work types
workTypes.description: Any of: full time, part time, contract, casual. Empty for all.

workArrangements.title: Work arrangements
workArrangements.description: Any of: on-site, hybrid, remote. Empty for all.

minSalary.title: Minimum salary
minSalary.description: The site's own salary filter, in local currency. 0 for no minimum.

postedWithinDays.title: Listed within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs listed in the last N days (up to 31). 0 for any age.

includeDescription.title: Full description
includeDescription.description: On: each job's full description (one extra call per job). Off: listing fields only, cheaper.

splitPastCap.title: Read past Seek's 540-result cap
splitPastCap.description: The sites return at most 540 jobs per search. On: a bigger search is split by work type, arrangement and category so every job can be read. Only used when you ask for more than 540.

onlyNew.title: Only jobs not returned before
onlyNew.description: On: each run returns only jobs earlier runs with the same search have not. For daily alerts on a schedule.

maxJobsPerSearch.title: Max jobs per keyword
maxJobsPerSearch.description: Per keyword (and per category, work type or arrangement combination).

maxJobs.title: Max jobs in total
maxJobs.description: Stop the run after this many jobs.
